tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// bcu gcig zhal gyi bsnyen thabs dri med phreng ba'i gsal byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// rmad byung thugs rje che mchog grur zhugs nas// lus can srid pa'i chu gter las gdon pa'i// khur chen khyer ba bla ma spyan ras gzigs// de yi bsnyen yig rnam gsal zur rgyan 'dri// dge slong ma dpal mo'i lugs kyi thugs rje chen po zhal bcu gcig pa'i bsnyen thabs ji ltar bya ba'i tshul phal cher/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs pas mdzad pa'i yi ge nas 'byung ba ltar las 'dir lhag po ma dgos shing*/ 'on kyang de'i skabs 'gar mi gsal ba'i cha'i gsal byed cung zad 'god pa la/ 'di'i bsnyen pa bya ba'i sgrub thabs dngos ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs ltar nyams su blangs nas/ bsnyen pa'i gtso bo gzungs ring ni/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na ma ārya dzñā na sogs nas/ dzwa la ma pa nā ya swā hā zhes pa'i bar te/ de nyid tshar gcig gam bdun la sogs pas sna drangs nas/ snying po zhes pa ni/ tadya thā/ oṃ dha ra dha ra sogs nas dzwa la ma pa nā ya swā hā zhes pa'i bar te/ de nyid 'bum phrag drug bsags pa ni bsnyen pa'o// de'i mthar yi ge drug pa cung zad kyang bsags pa ni/ 'di'i sgrub thabs dang smyung gnas kyi yi ge 'ga' zhig tu 'byung ba ltar byung na legs/ de'i bsnyen pa'i dngos gzhi grub pas/ thugs rje chen po yid bzhin 'khor lo'i gzungs stong phrag bsags gsungs pa ltar grub na mchog tu bzang zhing*/ de'i snying po/ nye snying gsang ba'i snying po rnams kyang ji ltar rigs pa bzla gsungs pa ltar bya/ rgyun gyi thugs dam sogs kyi mthar yang nyung tsam bzla ba byung na byin rlabs dang phan yon ches che ba bshad pa bzhin no// gzhan du thugs dam sogs la dkyus ma ltar las ma byung yang chad pa'i skyon du 'gyur ba ga la yod/ de bzhin du pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi gzungs dang sa bcu pa dang*/

snang ba mtha' yas kyi gzungs rnams kyang nyin re bzhin du mang nyung ji ltar rigs par bzla grub na/ dkyus nas bshad pa lta bu'i phan yon che ba dang*/ khyad par gtso bo 'di rnams gso sbyong gi sdom pa blangs pa dang*/ smyung bar gnas pa la gnas pas bzlas na phan yon tshad med par 'byung ba la dgongs pas te/ ji skad du/ gzungs 'di smyung bar gnas te/ gso sbyong gi yan lag brgyad bzung nas mi smra bar lan nyi shu rtsa gcig dran par bya'o zhes sogs dang*/ dge slong gang zhig tshul khrims nyams pas smyung bar gnas te 'di bzlas brjod byas na/ bzlas brjod byas pa'i mod la tshul khrims yongs su dag par 'gyur zhing*/ tshul khrims mang po dang ldan par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pa lta bu la sogs pa phan yon mang du 'byung ba'i don du mdzad de/ sngags 'di rnams bzla bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro// des na gzungs sngags 'di rnams nam bzla ba'i dus ni/ thun mtshams la sogs pa gang yang rung bar 'don chog ste/ gso sbyong smyung gnas sogs kyi skabs yin na/ sngar phyag mchod kyi yul du spyan drangs pa'i bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas rnams dang*/ dngos su bshams pa'i bcu gcig zhal la sogs pa'i rten bshams pa rnams dang dbyer med pa dmigs pa'i mdun nam/ rten de dag med kyang rung ste/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la sogs pa'i spyan sngar gnas pa'i 'dun pa bcas te sngags bzlas pas bya rgyud rang rkang gi lugs ltar 'gyur te/ gzungs dngos las kyang gzungs 'di 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la dmigs nas yid rtse gcig tu byas te dran par byas na/ dran pa tsam gyi mod la bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pa lta bu dang*/ ye shes rdo rje kun nas btus pa'i rgyud las/ bdag nyid lha yi snyems pa med pa dang*// ye shes sems dpa'i bde ba med pa ni// bya ba'i rgyud la bzhugs so zhes gsungs pa'i don du snang ba'i phyir ro// yang na rang nyid sngar 'phags pa bcu gcig zhal lta bu'i yi dam gyi lha gang yin gyi sgrub thabs nyams su blangs pa'i thun mtshams lta bur yang rang nyid tha mal pa'i rnam pa ma yin par/

lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas bzlas kyang legs pa yin te/ gzungs sngags 'di rnams phal cher bya ba'i rgyud nas bstan pa yin mod/ 'di dag rigs la bdag lhar bskyed pa dang cho ga'i yan lag phal cher rnal 'byor rgyud kyi lugs kyis rgyas bkab pa shas cher 'byung ba ltar te/ dper na/ 'on kyang gsang sngags lugs byed na// yi dam bsgom pa bsod nams che// zhes dang*/ bdag nyid lha ru bskyed pa la// mchod na bsod nams brnyas na sdig /ces sogs rgya cher 'byung ba'i don du snang ngo*// de lta bu'i tshul gyis bcu gcig zhal gyi sgrub thabs la brten nas bsnyen pa sngon du song ba yin na rab/ ma song bas kyang rung ste smyung bar gnas pa'i cho ga ji ltar bya ba ni/ cho 'phul gyi zla ba'am sa ga zla ba la sogs pa gang yang rung ba'i tshes bdun lta bu la/ nangs par gso sbyong gi sdom pa 'bogs len nas brtsams te smyung gnas kyi cho ga tshar gsum btang ba ni smyung gnas rkyang pa dang*/ tshes brgyad lta bu la gso sbyong nas brtsams te cho ga tshar gsum re la mchod pa byin rlabs nas bsngo ba smon lam gyi bar rgyas bsdus kyi khyad par nyung zad byas na min pa thams cad tshang bar bya ba ni khug pa ste/ de gnyis spel ba zhag nyer gcig bar du nyams su len pa ni sgrub bsnyen te/ nam grol ba'i nyin skya rengs shar ba'i dus nas brtsams te gso sbyong dor ba ma gtogs cho ga tshar gcig btang nas mthar bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya ba yin no// des na dus bzang po sogs la smyung gnas byed na'ang rkyang khug rjes gsum la nyin gsum par 'gyur gyis/ nyin gcig par bya ba'i thabs ni ma mchis so// de'ang rkyang pa'i dus na dkar gsum la brten pa'i zas gdan gcig bya/ ngag bcad mi byed kyang ngag 'khyal gyi rigs spong*/ khug pa'i nyin ngag bcad shin du dam par bya ba dang*/ mid pa rgyun bcad pa sogs cho ga'i dkyus nas 'byung ba ltar bya ste/

de dag gi lag len rags rim tsam las shin tu zhib 'khod 'dir 'dri longs ma byung yang*/ 'di skor gyi gsal byed don gnyer 'ga' zhig gi ched du smyung gnas kyi cho ga sdig sgrib rnam sbyong zhes bya ba zhig kho bos byas pa yod pa des kyang phyogs re nas gsal byed du 'gyur las che snyam pa yod pas der gzigs mdzod/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs zhal gyi lung*// bcu gcig zhal gyi bsnyen thabs dri med phreng*// gsal byed sgron chung bteg pas sems can gyi// rnam grol lam gyi snang byed nyid gyur cig /ces bcu gcig zhal gyi bsnyen thabs dri med phreng ba'i gsal byed 'di'ang*/ thar lam dgon gyi dbu mdzad dge bshes tshul khrims grags pa'i gsung gis bskul ngor bande tshul rin gyis bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
